info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Commission Agreement Management API
info.description: The Commission Agreement Management API allows businesses to update the details of existing commission agreements for their sales operations. By utilizing this endpoint, authorized users can modify terms, rates, and conditions associated with specific agreements, enhancing flexibility in managing compensation structures. This API is particularly useful for sales teams and financial departments that need to adapt to changing business requirements quickly. Through the PATCH method, businesses ensure that their commission agreements remain current and aligned with organizational goals.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific sales commission agreement identified by the resource ID provided. Ensure that the appropriate fields are included in the patch request to modify the agreement correctly.
